name: FloatingAssistant
intent: An AI assistant that docks to the right of the page: an icon-only, corner-anchored trigger opens a full-height chat panel powered by `AIChat`. The panel takes layout width rather than floating over the page — pass the page content as `children` and it narrows to make room (built on `PushPanel`). The conversation is controlled by the consumer (`messages` + `onSendMessage`), so any domain logic can drive the replies. The trigger is the bare Core brand mark with no chrome behind it — it takes `currentColor` from `foreground`, so it inverts with the theme. Pass `icon` to swap in any other glyph. A detach control in the panel header lifts the conversation out of the layout into a floating card anchored above the trigger, and docks it back; the transition fades and scales over 200ms.

usage: Use FloatingAssistant to enhance your user interface. This component provides a consistent, accessible, and well-designed solution for this use case.
FloatingAssistant integrates seamlessly with other components in the design system. Follow the established patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency across your application.

props.name: messages
props.description: Conversation messages (controlled).

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Loading state while `onSendMessage` runs.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit to let the widget manage its own.

props.name: icon
props.description: Trigger icon, shown bare with no chrome. Defaults to the Core brand mark.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the trigger.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the trigger while a detached panel is open.

props.name: detachable
props.description: Hides the header's detach/dock toggle.

props.name: title
props.description: Empty-state heading inside the panel.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Empty-state subtitle.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Composer placeholder.

props.name: suggestedPrompts
props.description: Quick-start prompts shown in the empty state.

props.name: sessionName
props.description: Conversation name shown in the panel header. Pass it (even as `""`) to render the name slot.

props.name: sessionNamePlaceholder
props.description: Shown while `sessionName` is empty.

props.name: availableContext
props.description: Items offered by the composer's "Add context" picker.

props.name: contextNote
props.description: Small note under the composer naming what the assistant can see — the page it is open on.

props.name: headerActions
props.description: Extra header actions, rendered between the built-in history action and the close button.

props.name: sessions
props.description: Past conversations. Providing them adds the history action to the panel header.

props.name: activeSessionId
props.description: Highlights the row for the conversation currently open.

props.name: children
props.description: The page content the panel docks beside. It narrows as the panel opens.

props.name: panelWidth
props.description: Docked panel width in px.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the layout row wrapping the page content and the panel.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply.

anatomy.description: FloatingAssistant is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
